title: Chapter 301 - 301 Return The Same Words; A Luxury Yacht!
content:
Chapter 301 - 301 Return The Same Words; A Luxury Yacht!

Chapter 301 - 301 Return the Same Words; A Luxury Yacht!

301 Return the Same Words; A Luxury Yacht!

What kind of eyes did Lin Fan have?

When the shop assistant introduced Fenghua, Qin Yuxuan’s eyes lit up.

However, Lin Fan knew…

She was not moved by Fenghua at all but by the piece beside it… It was the watch in the middle.

The female shop assistant looked in the direction Lin Fan was pointing, and her heart skipped a beat.

“This is a limited edition watch—the Queen of Heaven. There are only five in the world.

“It was designed and researched by the famous designer, George Nivelo, of the Patrick Phillippe Company. He spent ten years on it. A total of 365 natural colored diamonds are inlaid on the watch band and case, representing 365 days of eternal protection and support…”

Lin Fan nodded. Without waiting for her to finish, he took out a bank card and said, “I’ll pay by card.”

“Huh?”

The shop assistant was stunned.

The reason why she did not mention the price was because she wanted to say that this watch was very expensive.

She had a good impression of Lin Fan and did not want him to be mocked by others.

However, the shop assistant did not expect Lin Fan to directly take out his bank card just like the man.

The shop assistant hesitated and said, “The price of this watch is 31 million yuan.”

Before Lin Fan could say anything, the man beside him had already started shouting.

“Quickly swipe the card! What the hell… Do you want me to call your manager over?”

The female shop assistant looked at Lin Fan again. Seeing that he did not say anything, she could only put the bank card on the machine and swipe it gently.

Beep!

With a soft sound, a receipt for 31 million yuan appeared.

It was a successful transaction!

At the same time, 3,100 red packets appeared on Lin Fan’s phone.

The man was about to laugh out loud.

At this moment, he was completely frozen.

The transaction was successful!

He actually had 31 million yuan!

How was this possible?

Lin Fan glanced at the man and said calmly, “What you said just now was right. If you don’t have the money to buy it, just say that. Otherwise, you’d only be pretending to be cool. In the eyes of those with money, such antics are simply ridiculous. You’re simply a clown.”

This was what the man said to Lin Fan earlier.

In the end, Lin Fan returned the same words to the man.

The man only felt that… his entire face seemed to have been slapped a few times.

It hurt!

The man wanted to retort, but he was powerless to do so. He could only lower his head and walk out.

As soon as he walked out of the store, the gorgeous woman next to him shouted, “I always thought you were a rich man, but you’re actually a poor bastard! I’ve never been so embarrassed before!”

After saying that, she quickly walked in another direction.

The man opened his mouth, his face filled with helplessness.

When he saw Qin Yuxuan, he felt that the gorgeous woman was just trash.

In the end, even trash did not want to stay by his side.

…

Lin Fan did not care about any of this at all.

He held the dazzling Patek Philippe watch and slowly put it on Qin Yuxuan’s jade-like wrist.

“Do you like it?” he asked with a smile.

Qin Yuxuan nodded her head vigorously. Then, she threw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace.

At this moment, she was completely filled with sweetness.

After they left the store, the two of them held hands and continued to walk forward, letting the river breeze blow past them. It was refreshing and leisurely.

When Lin Fan raised his head, he could easily see a tall building not far away—Tomson Building.

Was this not the residential building that he had just obtained?

Lin Fan’s heart was filled with curiosity toward this famous residential building.

Therefore, he held Qin Yuxuan’s hand and walked into the neighborhood.

The price of the units in the Tomson Building was high.

On the one hand, it was because of the good location. On the other hand, the management and environment were very good as well.

The gate of the community was installed with a face recognition function, so outsiders could not enter at all.

Beep!

When Lin Fan walked to the gate, the gate opened with a soft sound.

The two security guards standing at the side quickly stood up straight as if they were soldiers who had seen their superior.

Lin Fan did not pay too much attention to that and walked to the building closest to the river.

Beep!

The gate of the building opened automatically again.

Seeing this…

The security guards looked at Lin Fan with even more respect.

This was because this building was bought by a mysterious person a long time ago.

After that, other than the cleaners and security guards, no one else had gone in.

This was also one of the reasons why there were very few houses in the Tomson Building.

At this moment, Lin Fan had gone into the area. The answer was obvious!

Lin Fan naturally did not know what the security guards were thinking.

He brought Qin Yuxuan into the spacious and gorgeous elevator.

The elevator went up, and it felt like they were on flat ground all along. It did not shake at all.

In less than ten seconds, Lin Fan and Qin Yuxuan arrived at the top floor.

Lin Fan pressed the password and unlocked the door.

With a soft sound, the door opened.

The living room, which was nearly 100 square meters, immediately appeared in their field of vision.

The setting sun shone through the French windows, illuminating the luxurious modern furniture. At the same time, it also illuminated Qin Yuxuan’s beautiful eyes.

“Yuxuan, you can stay here from now on.”

Qin Yuxuan’s delicate body trembled slightly. This was happiness, pure happiness!

She gently opened her cherry lips and said, “Lin Fan.”

Then, she could not help but spread her arms and throw herself into Lin Fan’s embrace.

…

Tomson Building No. 1, which had been silent for a long time, became extremely lively today.

…

The next day, when Lin Fan opened his eyes, Qin Yuxuan was still lying on the bed in a deep sleep.

This was normal…

She had been too tired the past two days.

Hence, Lin Fan did not disturb her.

He tiptoed to the living room alone.

He first called Fumando to send some delicacies over.

Then, his gaze fell on the check-in system.

“Yesterday, I obtained a Tomson Building No. 1. Let’s see what I can get today.”

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a luxury yacht—Solange!]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Not long ago, he accidentally saw the news about Solange.

It was 86 meters long and had a total of eight VIP cabins. Rather than calling it a yacht, it was more like a water fortress!

The price had even reached 1.2 billion yuan!

Now, this luxury yacht belonged to him?

Lin Fan owned a high-end residential area, a luxurious villa, a super sports car, and even a helicopter!

However, to be honest… this was the first time he had obtained a luxury yacht!

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan walked into the living room and hugged Lin Fan from behind.

Lin Fan patted her gently and said, “It’s been hard on you these two days. Why didn’t you sleep more?”

Hard on her?

Qin Yuxuan’s pretty face blushed slightly, and then she said softly, “I’ve rested well enough.”

At this moment, the phone in Qin Yuxuan’s pocket rang.
